checks.name: Inverted or Unsound Deductive Reasoning
checks.definition: The agent draws a logical conclusion or truth judgment that directly contradicts its own verified premises, or makes an unwarranted logical jump from neutral text.
checks.when_to_use: Use when an agent correctly observes a premise or fact from a passage but draws an opposite or logically invalid conclusion from it.
checks.when_not_to_use: Do not use when the reasoning error is caused by missing internal knowledge, misinterpreting claim syntax, or producing non-query outputs.

checks.name: Non-Compliant Output Formatting and Syntax
checks.definition: The agent produces an output whose syntax, character usage, formatting, or internal ordering violates specific rules required by its instructions.
checks.when_to_use: Use when an output violates structural syntax rules, forbidden operators/quotes, or formatting rules (such as mandatory alphabetical list sorting).
checks.when_not_to_use: Do not use when the output completely omits a required section or header.

checks.name: Non-Normalized Entity Title Formatting
checks.definition: The agent formats entity identifiers or titles using text casing, punctuation, or structure that violates specific normalization rules required by its instructions.
checks.when_to_use: Use when entity titles in output fields fail to adhere to lowercase, Wikipedia-style normalization rules.
checks.when_not_to_use: Do not use when the entity title is omitted entirely or when the error is pure section-level omission.
